title: HDFC SAP Concur Solutions Black Corporate credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A corporate-focused SAP Concur Solutions Black card providing premium travel privileges, expense management integration, and rewards on corporate spends.

items.child: 4% off on Flights and Hotels Booking

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Air accidental death cover up to ₹1 crore.|Emergency medical expenses cover up to ₹1 lakh while travelling abroad.|Loss of checked baggage cover up to ₹15,000 for the primary cardholder.|Missed connecting international flight cover up to ₹15,000 for the primary cardholder.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Avail Insurance package starting at an annual premium of Rs.3,785 which includes the above.
